name: Ermen
found: Northern Woods, at his clamps half a day north of the trailhead.
appearance: Soot-black. Singed beard. Smells of smoke.
sayings: Something leaves me a bone every week. Good neighbour.
wants: Torvek to pay for last season's charcoal.
oddly_also: Keeps every bone in a sack. 14 so far.
knows: Something big walks his clearing at night.
offers: Charcoal; a night by his clamp.
dm_notes: Ashfang gnolls leave the bones as offerings to his fire. They will not harm a fire-keeper.
campaign_notes: Created 2026-10-07 in the Nemetra NPC quality test; drawn from Drive 'Nemetra Gnoll Threat'.
